source.caveat: Titles, times, and guests may be subject to change. Event locations will be announced closer to the event; Behind the Card Frame is in the Signia Ballroom.

sessions.title: BL Progressive Sealed League
sessions.detail: Pick up 4 Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek play boosters starting Thursday and build a 40-card deck. Play at least 2 games each day Friday through Sunday to add a Star Trek Collector Booster to your pool the following day. Six games earn three total boosters. Final booster-prize claim: Sunday at 5 PM. Playing and defeating Wizards staff or special guests in the lounge may earn additional prizes.

facts.label: Prep
facts.value: Build a 40-card deck from 4 Star Trek play boosters

sessions.title: BL First Look Thursday
sessions.format: First Look / Behind the Card Frame
sessions.detail: First Look activities are consolidated at the MagicCon venue. Behind the Card Frame runs in the Signia Ballroom. Individual sessions below have their own published times; use those for your Plan rather than duplicating the whole program block.

sessions.title: Welcome to MagicCon: Atlanta and the Black Lotus Lounge
sessions.detail: Opening welcome for the Black Lotus Thursday program.

sessions.title: What Goes Into Flavor Text — Reality Fracture Edition
sessions.detail: The official Thursday schedule now names the former 2 PM content slot: What Goes Into Flavor Text Reality Fracture Edition.

sessions.title: Reality Fracture Concept Art Wall
sessions.detail: The official Thursday schedule lists the Reality Fracture Concept Art Wall at 3 PM, with no end time. This is a start-time reference rather than a fixed-duration Plan block.

sessions.title: Iconic Deck Histories: Control
sessions.detail: Hosted by Brian David-Marshall with special guests. This is a newly identified session; saved choices for the former unnamed 5:30 PM slot do not apply to it.

sessions.title: Design the Unknown Planechase Card
sessions.detail: Create a new plane for a future exclusive Black Lotus VIP event with the Casual Play Design team. Bring ideas and hone your design skills. Hosted by Melissa DeTora, Megan Smith, Elizabeth Rice, and Gabriel Dix.

sessions.title: Black Lotus Paint & Sip
sessions.detail: Join Magic Art Director Brittney Irving and a renowned Magic artist for a Bob Ross-style paint along with themed cocktails. Designed for fans of all artistic backgrounds.

sessions.title: Black Lotus Partner Showcase
sessions.detail: Find out what is on the horizon for Magic with its partners for 2027. The source omits the meridiem on this line; PM follows the Thursday evening schedule context.

sessions.title: BL Welcome Reception + First Look
sessions.detail: Casual mixer with Wizards of the Coast members and special guests. Chat, grab a signature, or discuss strategy and design. Light food provided; no-host bar.
